state:
- The initiating claim names CDK5 and Nup98 but leaves every modified residue to a post-hoc occupancy gate, so the molecular event is not fixed before testing and an empty gate only retires the kinase. Pre-register one Nup98 site or a short candidate list, and falsify kinase assignment separately from barrier initiation.
- The assumed order cites S3 after a chain that includes CDK5 activation and Nup98 phosphorylation, while S3 supports cytoplasmic TDP-43 assemblies, transport-factor mislocalization, nuclear TDP-43 loss, and cell death. Attach S3 only to those events and mark each earlier arrow as an uncited assumption.
- Falsification hinges on a ≥30% NLS nuclear-to-cytoplasmic drop, whereas the stated FG-barrier mechanism also predicts NES-export loss and a shift between ~20 kDa and ~70 kDa passive leak. Require the size-step leak to move in the same interval, derive cutoffs from assay variance, and specify how S/T-to-A or S/T-to-D Nup98 reaches ≥70% of NPC-resident Nup98 in these neurons.
